cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(OpenGridXREnhancements VERSION 0.2.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
option(DEPTHXR_BUILD_LAYER "Build the private native engine" ON)
option(DEPTHXR_BUILD_TESTS "Build native engine test targets" ON)
option(DEPTHXR_BUILD_HARDWARE_PROBES "Build actual runtime clients" OFF)
option(DEPTHXR_FRAMEGEN_SPIRV "Build native Vulkan compute shaders" OFF)
include(CTest)
add_subdirectory(layer)
add_executable(opengrid-enhancements-policy-tests layer/tests/opengrid_policy_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(opengrid-enhancements-policy-tests PRIVATE depthxr_core depthxr_osd)
add_test(NAME opengrid-enhancements-policy COMMAND opengrid-enhancements-policy-tests)
